news.title: 17-year-old charged in deadly wrong-way crash after police chase
news.summary: A 17-year-old driving with four passengers after 1 a.m. ran from Lawrenceville police and crashed head-on in the wrong lanes of a Gwinnett County highway, killing a 33-year-old driver, warrants say.

news.title: Police: 3 women arrested during rent fraud investigation in East Point
news.summary: Investigators found over 120 missing or fraudulent money orders involving more than 60 victims and over $65,000 in suspected losses at the Fulton Pointe Apartments.

news.title: Prosecutors seek interviews with youths in Kroy Biermann Jr. sexual assault case
news.summary: The Fulton County district attorney has issued emergency orders calling for forensic interviews and order a hearing to modify of bond conditions in connection with the case of Kroy Biermann Jr.

news.title: Teen accused of having sex with 15-year-old in metro Atlanta high school band room
news.summary: A metro Atlanta teenager is accused of soliciting a 15-year-old girl for sex and sending her explicit pictures, according to a Cobb County arrest warrant.

news.title: Man knocked out cold in downtown Atlanta robbery wants justice
news.summary: Atlanta police are searching for a thief who knocked a man unconscious and robbed him on Baker Street in downtown Atlanta late on July 25.

news.title: Man shot and killed at home in North Druid Hills area
news.summary: DeKalb County Police said they responded to a location on Fisher Trail late Thursday.

news.title: Inmate serving time for gang activity named as suspect in Norcross cold case, GBI says
news.summary: With the help of advanced DNA testing, authorities identified the suspect, who is already incarcerated on other unrelated charges.

news.title: Motorcyclist sought after Stockbridge High vandalism
news.summary: Henry County police are searching for a motorcyclist accused of vandalizing property at Stockbridge High School.

news.title: Suspect arrested in shooting over bicycle in Clayton County
news.summary: Clayton County police have arrested a suspect in an August shooting that investigators say began with a confrontation over a bicycle.
